meta.title: GitHub
meta.description: Connect your GitHub account through the official remote GitHub MCP Server to create public or private repositories and upload or delete repository content from the conversation. Tools appear as mcp__github__<tool> and work with any tool-calling model. Requires a fine-grained PAT stored as the GITHUB_MCP_PAT credential (Contents: Read and write, Metadata: Read; add Administration: Read and write to delete whole repositories). Deleting files or repositories cannot be undone, so confirm each deletion before running it.
